_law: ONLY SHRINKS. This file lists the ledger numbers KNOWN to be cited but never written — the §683 class (ODQ §685.5(vi), measured at §920, instrumented at §921). A NEW number fails tests/lint/ledgerCitationIntegrity.test.js; a number whose citations have all gone also fails, with 'delete its entry'. The set can only fall. It holds the SET, never the counts: a count assertion would red every time a chair legitimately writes '§683' again, and a gate that reds on correct behaviour gets turned off. A number is NEVER silenced by editing this file - a false alarm is silenced by adding a PROVED alias to ALIASES in scripts/audit/ledger-citations.mjs, whose proof string is checked against the live corpus on every run.
